subject: english-literature
title: Five Steps Up the Pyramid
welcome_lead: Most stories climb a pyramid and then descend. Let's map the steps.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on the five-stage plot structure.
final_note: You can now identify exposition through resolution.

concepts.def: Opening that sets up world and people.
Events that build tension toward climax.
Peak turning point of the story.
The ending that ties off the conflict.
Diagram of the five plot stages.

walkthroughs.body_html: Most stories follow exposition → rising action → climax → falling action → resolution. This is the backbone of plot.
The climax is the highest tension — the moment that decides the outcome. Everything before builds toward it; everything after falls from it.
Gustav Freytag drew the five-stage plot as a pyramid. Use it to plan or analyse stories at a glance.
